title: 第88章 奇怪的雕像第87章 进入遗迹
slug: 玄幻我有机甲鬼才愿意去修仙
content_zh:
“主人，这是什么地方？难道这才是他们说的遗迹？”
石泉水从岩浆内消失后，就被传送到一个虚无的世界内。
四周都是漂浮的宝物，宝物上都贴着封印，显得有些古怪。
“哪有那么简单。”石泉水淬了一声便研究起四周的宝物，“金蛇，你觉不觉得是陷阱？”
“宝物看起来都像真的，好像觉察不出有问题。会不会主人进来后给主人挑选的机会？”
连金蛇都判断不出真假，石泉水如果不是对灵气的感知度提升到一个非常高的程度，他也会如此认为。
封印真的，不知道的还真以为是真的。
“既然是假的，那没必要多看了。这里有一条灵气流动指向一个方向。”
这地方看起来非常大，到处都是宝物，数量之多比上古时期十个大宗门加起来还多。
“主人，外面有很多灵力波动，应该进来了不少修士。”
“这里应该有某种禁制，我进来的时候就在此地，他们若是要进此地，恐怕需要点时间。我得加快速度。”
石泉水立即加速。
前方一个大炉鼎突然爆开，出现了一个抱膝的元神。
看起来像是沉睡了许多年。
元神周围还充满着非常重的死气，俨然像是濒死状态。
他慢慢飞了过去，距离六七米便停下。
“主人，这么巧就等着主人？会不会是陷阱？”
石泉水放出神识迅速靠近元神。
靠近半米左右，元神体内释放出非常强的威压直接将神识吞噬。
“是谁？”

声音骤然响起。
石泉水自知遇到了麻烦，便俯首一拜：“晚辈石泉水拜见前辈。晚辈是无意间闯入此地，还请前辈恕罪。”
“恕罪？你知道本尊是谁？就敢贸然攻击？”
声音很冷，给人一种藐视一切的感觉。
“主人......”
金蛇刚要说，一道非常强悍的神识直接击穿了金蛇身体。
而石泉水本身就没有任何不适。
“聒噪，这里有你说话的份？再放肆，下次直接灭了你。”
石泉水心里咯噔一下，元神能直接攻击其本身实力一定非常强，说不定真是仙人。
“前辈，他不是存心的，还请前辈恕罪。”
“你来干什么？找宝物，那你自己去找。”
石泉水眼眸一凝，元神看起来很好恕罪，实则前后态度完全不一样，似乎很期待他去找宝物。
content_en:
"Master, what is this place? Is this the ruins they are talking about?"
After the stone spring water disappeared from the magma, it was transported to a world of nothingness.
There are floating treasures all around, and the treasures have seals on them, which looks a bit weird.
"It's not that simple." The stone spring water was quenched and then he studied the treasures around him, "Golden Snake, do you think it's a trap?"
"The treasures all look real, and there seems to be no problem. Will the owner be given a chance to choose after he comes in?"
Even Golden Snake couldn't tell the truth from falsehood. If Shi Quanshui's perception of spiritual energy hadn't been raised to a very high level, he would have thought so.
The seal is real, and those who don’t know it actually think it is real.
"Since it is fake, there is no need to look further. There is a flow of spiritual energy here pointing in one direction."
This place looks very big, with treasures everywhere, more than the ten major sects combined in ancient times.
"Master, there are a lot of spiritual energy fluctuations outside, and there should be many monks coming in."
"There should be some kind of restriction here. I was here when I came in. If they want to enter here, I'm afraid it will take some time. I have to speed up."
The stone spring water immediately accelerated.
A large cauldron in front suddenly exploded, and a Yuanshen hugging his knees appeared.
It looks like it has been sleeping for many years.
The soul is still surrounded by a very heavy death energy, as if it is on the verge of death.
He slowly flew over and stopped six or seven meters away.
"Master, are you waiting for me by such a coincidence? Could it be a trap?"
The stone spring water releases spiritual consciousness and quickly approaches the soul.
About half a meter closer, a very strong coercion was released from Yuanshen's body, which directly swallowed up the consciousness.
"Who is it?"
The voice suddenly sounded.
Shi Quanshui knew he was in trouble, so he bowed his head and said, "Junior Shi Quanshui pays homage to senior. Junior broke into this place unintentionally, and please forgive me, senior."
"Excuse me? You know who I am? How dare you attack rashly?"
The voice was cold, giving people a feeling of contempt for everything.
"Master..."
Just as the Golden Snake was about to say something, a very powerful spiritual consciousness directly penetrated the Golden Snake's body.
There is no discomfort in the stone spring water itself.
"Nao Nao, do you have the right to speak here? If you continue to be presumptuous, I will kill you directly next time."
Shi Quanshui's heart skipped a beat. The soul that could directly attack it must be very powerful. Maybe it was an immortal.
"Senior, he didn't mean it. Please forgive me, senior."
"What are you here for? Looking for treasure, then you can find it yourself."
Shi Quanshui's eyes narrowed. Yuanshen seemed to be very forgiving, but in fact his attitude was completely different. He seemed to be looking forward to finding the treasure.
